title: An actively trained neural operator for near-explicit atmospheric chemistry
abstract: arXiv:2610.33771v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Earth-system models simplify atmospheric chemistry into condensed mechanisms, because near-explicit mechanisms such as the Master Chemical Mechanism (MCM) are too costly to solve in every grid cell. Neural emulators could lift this limit, but most advance the chemistry in small time steps and cover only a few species or a reduced mechanism. Here we introduce FNO-MoE, a Fourier neural operator with a mixture of experts that predicts the full near-explicit chemical state over 30 minutes in a single call. The same network also guides its own training, using the disagreement among its experts to select the most informative box-model simulations. At equal cost, this active sampling yields a more accurate emulator than random or evenly spread sampling. translated_title: 面向近显式大气化学的主动训练神经算子
translated_abstract: 地球系统模型之所以将大气化学简化为凝聚机制，是因为像主化学机制（MCM）这样的近显式机制在每个网格单元中求解的代价过于高昂。神经模拟器有望突破这一限制，但现有的神经模拟器大多以小时间步长推进化学反应，且仅覆盖少数物种或简化的机制。本文提出了FNO-MoE，一种融合了专家混合的傅里叶神经算子，可以在单次调用中预测30分钟内完整的近显式化学状态。该网络还能指导自身的训练过程，利用其内部专家之间的分歧来选取信息量最大的箱式模型模拟。在相同计算成本下，这种主动采样策略比随机采样或均匀采样能获得更精确的模拟器。在更长的化学轨迹上进行微调后，模型在多小时运行中保持稳定，而仅用短时模拟训练的模型则会出现发散。由此得到的模拟器能够再现数千个物种的演化（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出FNO-MoE——一种结合专家混合机制的傅里叶神经算子，可单次调用预测30分钟内的完整近显式大气化学状态，并利用专家间分歧进行主动采样自我训练，以远低于求解MCM的成本实现精确且稳定的多小时化学演化模拟。
en_tdlr: FNO-MoE, a Fourier neural operator with a mixture-of-experts architecture, predicts the full near-explicit atmospheric chemical state over 30 minutes in a single call, and actively trains itself by using expert disagreement to select the most informative simulations, enabling accurate and stable multi-hour emulation at a fraction of the cost of solving the Master Chemical Mechanism.
